title: 60-Second Reset
concept: A one-minute reset for when winning has replaced connecting. It stops the damage fast; then you book proper time to work it out. Save it for the bad moments, not every disagreement.
whenToUse: When a fight is starting and you’re both still in the room, willing to stop for one minute. Too hot to stay in the room? Take a Pause + Return instead.
steps: Stop: let go of winning or solving it for now.
Say one sentence: “I want to connect, not fight. Can we talk at ___?”
Touch, only if it’s welcome. Keep it brief.
Breathe: take three slow breaths together.
Return at the time you named, and keep it.

phrases.text: I want to connect, not fight.
I’m stopping so we don’t do damage.

working: They’re mid-row over the holiday budget. A: “I want to connect, not fight. Can we talk at 8pm?” They breathe together. B agrees. The budget waits till 8.
notWorking: B uses it to shut the conversation down for good: “60-Second Reset, I’m done,” with no time to come back. That’s walking away with extra steps.
activity: Practise the five steps on a fake topic (“dishes”) three times while you’re both calm. Agree the phrase you’ll actually use.
